lines.en: label dormwarsfive6:
scene sky
One by one, the girls begin to pour out of the library and head over to...wherever we’re going next. I’m not really sure.
And to be honest, I’m not really excited either.
Maya still isn’t Maya. And even if I’m a little more open to her...existence now than I was in the past, I’m still not fond of the idea of sitting there while she berates me.
All I’ll do is project. And trick myself into believing there’s something I can do to get mine back when I know it isn’t up to me.
I’m curious about how she’ll handle it, though, because she’s walking on eggshells too. And I bet part of her wishes she could just sleep with me and win the contest that way.
Assuming it’ll be a contest at all, of course. Because when it comes to making me feel bad, there is no one better at it than her.
It only makes sense that the opposite would be true as well.
Somehow or another, I’m still wrapped around her finger — even when she’s nowhere to be found.
scene benicetosensei1
: And we’re back! With hopefully another fun competition instead of one where we just make everybody feel bad for a solid hour.
: If that happens today, we can assume the contest was a complete failure. I better leave this room feeling better than I ever have before.
: It’s against the rules. It was the first thing I thought about as well.
: Not...what I meant.
: Oh damn. I guess there is chemistry there after all. It’s just never been that apparent to me until right now.
scene benicetosensei2
: We have exchanged one sentence.
: Sometimes, that’s all it takes.
: Uhh...anyway. The rules of the contest are simple.
scene benicetosensei3
: You’ll both get to spend a total of five minutes with Sensei. Within that time-
: Sorry, just five? The date war girls get like four hours.
: Are you implying you could be nice to this heathen for longer than twenty minutes tops?
: If he tapes my mouth shut, sure.
scene benicetosensei4
: I’d kind of love to, I won’t lie.
: Such a siscon. What would Mom and Dad say if they heard that?
: Ohhh, so I’m not the only one here with good chemistry. Thanks for showing me. I hate it.
scene benicetosensei5
: Don’t worry, Maya. I’d still choose you if you were an option.
: You’d be foolish not to. I’m demonstrably better.
: Oh, okay. Now I hate this.
: Either I explain the rules or I get to join in on the flirting too. Take your pick.
scene benicetosensei6
: I’ll go lie down on the couch. You three know what to do from there.
: Imani leaves the room for one minute and his true colors immediately show. That didn’t take very long.
: Go ahead, Ayane. Explain your rules since they’re apparently more complicated than just lying to him until he feels good about himself.
scene benicetosensei7
: They’re not. The name of the contest pretty accurately sums it up. Just be nice to him and he’ll choose a winner once you’ve both had your turns.
: Again- only five minutes, though. We’ve got the lawyer contest next and, if I know anything about the court of law, which I do, I imagine that one will take a while.
: Interesting.
: Okay. Let’s see how this goes. Otoha, would you like the honors of going first?
: Sure. Just to confirm, though — Tsuneyo will step in when he tries to touch me, right?
scene benicetosensei8
: Nope! I will. I’ll just ask that everybody leaves the room for ten minutes so I can properly scold him.
: I wonder if this is how I looked to everybody at my last school?
: You mean burdened by the weight of everyone’s unquenchable desire?
: Pretty much, yeah.
scene black
: We’ll start the clock once you guys are seated!
: Maya — if you could please step away and refrain from making eye contact with either of them until their time is up, it would be greatly appreciated.
: Fine. I’ll just be standing over there in the corner...missing my beloved Sensei.
: Ah! Nope! No head-starts!
: Hm? Head start to what? Why are we here again?
: Sensei, shield your ears! Otoha, do something else!
: Come on, little bro! Let’s sit on the couch and you can tell me about your day.
scene benicetosensei9
: Oh, Io! I didn’t expect you to be here. And I feel kind of bad because Miku just ran off to look for you.
: Did she? Why?
: I think to compensate for how bad she’s currently feeling about herself.
: Yeah, that makes sense. Anyone would feel better about themselves standing next to me.
: Not me. If that were true, I’d have a much easier time falling asleep at night by now.
: I’m surprised you don’t after finally kissing-
scene benicetosensei10
: SHHHH!!! Are you TRYING to get me killed?! Do you see how many girls are in this room?!
: I am friggin’ DONE for if these people find out someone outside of the top five kissed him!
: I don’t like that sentence because it implies that Sensei is kissing his niece.
scene benicetosensei11
: I mean, would that really be all that crazy to assume?
scene benicetosensei12
: Touka, do you think I’m strange because I want to make out with my dad?
: Yes.
: So you don’t feel that way about your dad?
: No.
: Hm.
scene benicetosensei13
: He’s probably just not as attractive as mine then, is he?
: You have chosen a very peculiar topic to discuss with someone you have extremely limited interactions with.
: Well you like Sensei, don’t you?
scene benicetosensei14
: Of course I like him. I’m competing in a contest to earn his favor, am I not?
: Technically, there isn’t a prize for this year that’s been announced yet.
: Yes, but we all know that he is the reason we do this to begin with. Which is why last year felt so...different when all was said and done.
: I wasn’t around for last year’s contest either. Maybe you just missed me?
scene benicetosensei15
: No...I don’t think that was it.
: You know — I’ve always kind of wanted to get to know you a little better.
: Please tell me it’s not because I remind you of your mother.
scene benicetosensei16
: HA!
scene benicetosensei17
: No, I just mean you’re a really...interesting person. I’ve always wondered what it would be like to just...have everything.
scene benicetosensei18
: Me and my dad don’t really come from money as I’m sure you’ve seen. We’ve always made pretty much enough to get by, but that’s it.
: No fancy stuff. No trips anywhere. But you-
scene benicetosensei19
: You’ve got it made!
: You don’t even have to work for anything. If you want something, you can just have it. That’s crazy.
: So you’re interested in my wealth, not me.
: Don’t get me wrong, Touka. I’m interested in you too. Just most of that personal interest is about the relationship you have with my dad.
: Your dad that you...want to French kiss.
scene benicetosensei20
: Oh, I want to do way more than that. How about you, though?
: I’m not sure that concerns you, Ami. Sensei is a grown man and doesn’t need your approval for anything even if I was pursuing him, which I am not.
: Oh? And I assume I'm just supposed to believe that?
: I’m sorry — are you trying to intimidate me right now? I’m somewhat unsure of what to take away from this strange interaction.
: I’m not really sure either. I can’t tell if I like you more or less now.
: You know, I may not remind you of your mother, but you certainly remind me of mine. You’re just significantly worse at what you’re doing than she is.
: Okay, I made up my mind. I do like you less.
: That is your prerogative. I will not weigh in on someone I do not yet understand.
scene benicetosensei21
: Let’s have a nice and fun Dorm Wars, Touka! Good luck!
: Such a strange family.
scene benicetosensei22
: So — do I have any shot of winning at all? Or is Romeo going to choose his Juliet no matter what?
: You have a perfectly good chance at winning as my Juliet is actually Niki.
: Ahh, so Romeo’s just here to brag.
: No. I’m just going to fend off any and all discussion about Maya as I’m already dreading having to talk to her for five whole minutes.
: And I’m better?
: Oh, absolutely.
scene benicetosensei23
: Wait, really?
: Yeah. I like being around you, Otoha. You’re like a nice break from the insanity that swallows every other aspect of my life.
: I have my moments of insanity too. You’re just not around to see most of them.
scene benicetosensei24
: For example — just last week, I had a four day stretch where I completely forgot to eat and shower because I was so engrossed in my work.
: You’ll be happy to hear I didn’t hit anyone, though. Look at me, Sensei. I’m growing as a person.
: You have since taken a shower, correct?
: Several, with my last one being just this morning. And seeing as I’m supposed to be nice to you right now, I give you full permission to be creepy and sniff my hair.
: If that happens again, let me know and I’ll come bring you food.
scene benicetosensei25
: Okay, hold up. This isn’t a “be nice to Otoha” competition. Just sit there and let me say some nice things about you. I practiced all night and only threw up once.
: I’d rather just talk normally if that’s okay. Forcing niceties out isn’t really going to make me feel good.
: Nothing’s going to make you feel good. You’re a miserable, miserable man.
scene benicetosensei26
: But you’ve been a wonderful, wonderful friend.
: At least if you cut out the terrible, terrible influence you’ve been on me. I used to be such a good girl. Now, I barely even call my parents.
: And I imagine it’s easiest to just blame me for that, right?
: Oh, absolutely. There’s nothing I won’t blame you for so long as it makes me feel better about myself. That’s how relationships work, right?
: I don’t think so, Otoha.
: Explains why I was such a shitty girlfriend, then.
: You can say that, sure. But I don’t think you or Rin honestly believe it.
scene benicetosensei27
: She doesn’t. She’s too...compassionate. I don’t think I’ll ever stop blaming myself for letting things go on for as long as they did, though.
: Bright side, though. I learned I’m pretty good at fingering, so that’s cool. Maybe either one of your Juliets will let me try it out on them one day?
: Nothing says “be nice to Sensei” like suggesting you finger his girlfriends.
scene benicetosensei28
: Hey, less work for you.
scene benicetosensei29
: On the real, though...how are you doing? Being back and whatnot. Feel weird?
: A little bit, yeah.
: You miss it?
: I miss you.
: Me specifically? Or “me” as in “everyone?”
: Everyone. You’re special- just not that special.
: What a coincidence! That’s exactly what you are to me.
: I’m excited to continue living a life of mutual acceptance beside you that will likely one day progress into a spontaneous makeout session that we both feel really awkward about afterward.
: Then what? It destroys our friendship?
: That or I poison myself when I realize I can’t live without you.
: You’re so cool.
: Want to body-swap? I get to fuck your girlfriend and you get to finally be good at something? IE: fingering. Both guitar and girls.
: I’m totally better at fingering than you.
: Hey — go put Rin out of her misery and we can put that theory to the test.
scene black
: Aaaaand time! Otoha, out! Maya, in!
: Damn. Five minutes already? I had so much fun talking to whatshisname that the time just flew right by.
: Later, Otoha. I’ll never forget that fateful conversation we had on the couch today.
: What conversation? Who are you?
scene benicetosensei30
: ...and that is the game of Death Ball.
: As you can see, all you need to do is defeat the ball itself. This can be done by throwing it into the moon. Do you have any questions?
: Yes. How did a documentary crew manage to conduct interviews with all of you in the future when the future hasn’t occurred yet?
: I believe that is called “post-production.” But I have also heard that the camera adds ten years to one’s appearance.
scene benicetosensei31
: Or does it deduct ten years from one’s lifespan? I can not recall. You would know more about this forbidden technology than I do.
: It’s neither, Kendo Princess! You’re clearly a time traveler! The proof keeps adding up! The documentary! Your memories! It’s all real!
scene benicetosensei32
: You are delusional and foolish. If I could travel through time, I would send myself back to  the period in which ramen rose to popularity and experience the boom myself.
: When...did that rise to popularity again?
: World War II.
scene benicetosensei33
: For the first time in my life, I feel as if it would be best to just keep my mouth shut.
: Hey guys, what are- oh shit! Is the documentary finally out?!
: Either that or there is a group of girls identical to us who experienced the same events and also filmed a documentary about it.
: This does not matter. Feast your eyes upon how attractive I will remain for the rest of my life.
scene benicetosensei34
: Start it from the beginning. I want to see Uta’s reaction to the reveal again.
: Tsuneyo! You’re supposed to be helping me prepare for my battle!
: In a moment, Emerald Guardian. For I would also like to see how attractive I was back in the glory days once more.
: That was a year ago! Just look in the mirror!
: Sooooo...five whole minutes.
scene benicetosensei35
: I’ve beaten that time before.
: You’re not talking about being nice, are you?
: If that’s what the kids are calling it these days, I guess I am.
scene benicetosensei36
: If I need to be overly nice, I will. The bridge of magpies only opens once a year, and I can see you there on the opposite end, Sensei.

: Now that you have given me the faintest sliver of hope, I am going to barrage you with niceties and suggestive dialogue so incessantly that you will have no choice but to give me daily semen injections again.
: You’re starting to sound like Noriko did when she came back.
scene benicetosensei37
: Nevermind, I hate you!
scene benicetosensei38
: Just kidding. Here. Want to jingle the bell? That always cheers you up, doesn’t it?
: Not sure if it’ll have the same effect when my mouth isn’t full, but I’m willing to try anything at this point.
: My Maya wouldn’t say that.
scene benicetosensei39
: Not even in private? Really?
: Never. She was cold through and through.
: Well, what was I like during sex then?
: We never...did that. At least...not until the end.
: So you...
: We were...together...
: But we didn’t have sex.
: That’s right.
: And you were okay with that.
: I was.
scene benicetosensei40
: And you’re 100%% sure “your Maya” looked like this.
: Of course. You have the same body. Same eyes. Same everything.
: Sorry, I’m just having a hard time wrapping my head around a reality in which we are together but you can resist me. Look at me. What are you thinking right now?
: Of jingling the bell in the impure way.
: Exactly.
scene benicetosensei41
: So why the fuck would-
: Because it didn’t matter. And also...because she wouldn’t let me.
scene benicetosensei42
: Huh?
: She thought it would reset me. And that was understandably not a risk she was willing to take after spending so long trying to find me.
scene benicetosensei43
: That would make a really good manga.
: That’s all you have to say?
: Right now, yeah.
: And if you knew everything that was going on inside of my head, you’d completely understand why I can’t immediately come up with whatever answer you want.
: This is just as hard for me as it is for you, you know. You’re...the only person I’ve ever felt anything for and you just...don’t even see me anymore. It sucks.
: It...really sucks.
scene benicetosensei44
: You know what? No! You be nice to me! I’ve earned it!
: What?
: Yeah! It’s the Be Nice to Maya Battle now! Spoil me! Pat my head! Do it or I’ll cry!
: Do you even know how to cry?
: I can figure it out!
: Ugh...god fucking damn it.
scene benicetosensei45
: Oh good, you’re already caving. I don’t like yelling.
: I just fucking hate how cute you are. It’s like wanting to hug a bear. I know you’ll eat me alive, but...I just can’t help it.
: You never could. And you want to know why, Sensei?
: Not if it’s just going to be you bragging about how adorable you are again.
scene benicetosensei46
: It’s because you-
scene benicetosensei47
: And me-
scene benicetosensei48
: Belong together.
: How’s that for nice?
: I’d give it a B. Not wordy enough.
: You’re only saying that because “your Maya” had millions of years to improve her dialogue and I’ve spent most of my time learning where you like being bitten.
: I’ll get better if you let me, though.
: You won’t even recognize me by the time we’re done.
scene black
: Yeah, I...
: I don’t think that’s possible...
scene benicetosensei49
: That’s so weird...
: They look so-
: Natural? I know. I hate it.
scene benicetosensei50
: You too, obviously. I know you and Sensei-
: Never like them.
scene benicetosensei51
: I kind of despise it, if we’re being totally honest. Which we probably shouldn’t be since we barely know each other.
: There’s just a point where fighting an unwinnable battle gets to someone. And I think I’m there.
: I don’t like watching those two anymore. It feels like one of them hasn’t earned it.
scene benicetosensei52
: Sorry about that. I don’t really want to drag you into my drama. There’s just only so much a bottle can hold, you know?
: Yeah...
scene benicetosensei53
: Anyway! It looks like Maya’s time is up, so-
: We can talk if you want, Ayane. We don’t need to be good friends to-
scene benicetosensei54
: I’m fine. But thank you, Otoha. I really appreciate that.
scene black
: BZZZZZT! Maya’s time is up now too! Off the couch! Come on! Get up!
Ayane drags Otoha to the middle of the room as Maya and I pull ourselves from the couch.
scene benicetosensei55
There are a few other girls in the room, but none of them seem to be paying much attention. And I imagine it’s because they assume I’ve already made up my mind.
I really haven’t, though. It’s hard to when I’m meant to judge what makes me happy and I’ve never really understood that.
A game is a game, though. And it’s not as if this one can end in a tie. So I’ll just...need to make a choice.
: Okay, Sensei! You’ve now experienced five minutes of somewhat private kindness from floor one and floor two!
: But, like many times before, the time has come to decide on a winner!
: So who will it be?
: Who makes you the happiest?
menu:
Maya

: It’s a tough choice, but...
: I...think I have to go with Maya.
scene benicetosensei56
: Like clockwork.
: And I didn’t even need to sleep with anybody.
: Congrats, Maya. I don’t know if I’m more upset that I lost or that I didn’t get to experience five full minutes of you saying nice things to me.
scene benicetosensei57
: Maybe later. I’m in a good mood now. Sorry if that breaks your heart.
: Only a little.
: Nice job, Maya. Your victory ties the game at 2-2.
Otoha
$ dormwars5floor2points += 1
$ otohahappywin = True
: It’s a tough choice, but...
: I think Otoha wins this one.
scene benicetosensei58
: She...does?
: Yeah. But that doesn’t mean our talk didn’t make me feel happy as well, Maya.
scene benicetosensei59
: It just made me feel...all sorts of things. It’s complicated.
: With Otoha, I feel like I can relax. And I’m not sure just how similar that is to happiness, but hers was the conversation that I felt like I needed a little more right now.
: Well...okay.
scene benicetosensei60
: If that’s what...you think is best.
: I assure you, I am just as shocked as you.
: There’s nothing to feel shocked about, Otoha! You made me feel good just now too.
: And with your win, I’m sure the entirety of the second floor is going to be happy since you guys have managed to take a 3-1 lead!
Ayane
$ dormwars5floor1points += 1
$ ayanehappywin = True
: You do.
scene benicetosensei61
: Congrats, Maya! I knew you-
scene benicetosensei62
: ...what?
: You make me the happiest, Ayane.
scene benicetosensei63
: But I’m not...
: I wasn’t in the contest. You can’t-
: All you asked is who makes me the happiest. And there is no one I know who brings me more consistent joy than you.
scene benicetosensei64
: Thank you for always being there for me.
: I love you.
scene benicetosensei65
: Oh, damn.
: Oh, damn...
: Love you too...Sensei...
: You...have no idea how...how much I needed to...hear that...
scene benicetosensei66
: Uhhhhhh...
: Please excuse me.
scene benicetosensei67
: Well, that was dramatic.
: You guys don’t mind, right? That there’s no real winner of the contest?
scene benicetosensei68
: I’m fine tying with Maya. I never really expected to win anyway.
: Just keep Ayane as the winner and give the point to the first floor so we can go into the next round tied. Sound good?
: I don’t really care about the score, but that option is closer to me winning, so I will accept.
scene black
: Done deal then! I’m gonna go meet up with Nodoka and make sure she isn’t about to throw herself off the roof. Later, guys! It’s been fun!
: Yeah...
: It has certainly been.

scene black
: On that note, though — it’s time to start heading outside! And hope that Molly and Ami don’t actually die!
: Is this Death Ball thing actually that scary? I still haven’t seen it.
: Oh, you sweet summer child.
: Don’t listen to Otoha. The Death Ball is nice. It’s just...misunderstood.
